results.question: Can I return opened earphones because I changed my mind?

results.question: How long does a UPI refund take?
results.answer: UPI refunds usually take 1-2 business days from the day the refund is started. The refund starts after your returned item is inspected and approved by a support manager [refunds.md].

results.question: How long do card refunds take?
results.answer: Card refunds usually take 5-7 business days from the day the refund is started, which happens after your returned item passes inspection at our warehouse within 2 business days of pickup [refunds.md].

results.question: What do I get if I choose store credit instead of a refund to my card?
results.answer: If you choose store credit instead of a refund to your card, you get 5% extra credit, and the store credit does not expire for 12 months. Also, store credit is applied instantly, unlike refunds to cards which take a few business days depending on the payment method [refunds.md].

results.question: Is shipping free on an order of 800 rupees?
results.answer: Shipping is free only when the order value is above ₹999. For an order of ₹800, shipping costs ₹79 [shipping.md#0].

results.question: Which cities get express delivery?
results.answer: Express delivery is available only in metro cities: Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and Pune. It costs ₹149 unless you are a Gold tier member (free on every order) or a Silver tier member (one free express delivery per month) [shipping.md#1, loyalty.md#3].

results.question: What is the warranty on a table fan?
results.answer: The warranty on a table fan is 24 months from the delivery date. It covers manufacturing defects and faults during normal use but not damage from water, drops, burns, or repairs by others. To claim, open a support ticket with your order number and a photo or video of the issue. We repair within 7 business days or replace if needed [warranty.md].

results.question: Does the warranty cover water damage?
results.answer: The warranty does not cover water or liquid damage, as well as drops and physical damage [policy warranty.md#2]. It only covers manufacturing defects and faults during normal use [policy warranty.md#1]. If you have an issue, you can open a support ticket with your order number and a photo or video of the problem [policy warranty.md#3].

results.question: What is the COD fee?
